newsitem.title: USA: American Biogenetic, Gull in venture.
newsitem.headline: American Biogenetic, Gull in venture.

text.p: American Biogenetic Sciences Inc and Gull Laboratories Inc said on Thursday they had signed a joint venture agreement to develop American Biogenetic's thrombus precursor protein test.
The test is for diagnosing the early onset of pathological blood clot formation in renal dialysis patients.
Gull will exclusively develop with American Biogenetic the protein test on a worldwide basis for thrombus detection in dialysis patients.
Gull will manufacture the products of the venture and American Biogenetic will supply the critical reagents.
The products will be marketed and sold by the joint venture.
Gull is a subsidiary of Fresenius AG. Fresenius is merging its dialysis business with W.R. Grace & Co's healthcare unit, National Medical Care, to form Fresenius Medical Care AG.
The merger will make Fresenius the majority shareholder of the world's largest dialysis products and services company.
